results.title: Reflection AI Aims to Disrupt the AI Market by Empowering Enterprises to Build Their Own Models
results.description: Reflection AI, an American startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers, is challenging the dominance of OpenAI and Anthropic by enabling businesses to create their own custom AI models. With significant investments from Nvidia and SpaceX, the company plans to launch an open-weight model that competes with the best in the field, advocating for a more open and accessible AI ecosystem free from reliance on closed systems or risky Chinese alternatives.

results.title: Renault appoints Michelin's Carine Damois as CFO after Minto departs
results.description: Renault Chief Financial Officer Duncan Minto is leaving Renault to "pursue new professional opportunities outside of the Group" after less than two years in the role, the carmaker said on Monday.
